background_story: Darren was a skilled craftsman and woodworker who had a passion for working with rare and exotic woods. He spent years searching for the perfect material to create a masterpiece, and finally, he stumbled upon a shipment of shittim wood, a type of acacia wood mentioned in the Bible. Intrigued by its rich history and beauty, Darren spent months carefully selecting and cutting the wood to create a stunning ark-inspired cabinet. As he worked, he felt a deep connection to the ancient craftsmen who had used shittim wood to build the original Ark of the Covenant. When the cabinet was complete, it was a breathtaking work of art, with intricate carvings and a rich, dark patina. Darren's creation was met with critical acclaim, and he became known as a master woodworker, sought after by collectors and connoisseurs.
